newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe says politicians decide Euro economic policy.
newsitem.headline: Juppe says politicians decide Euro economic policy.

text.p: French prime minister Alain Juppe said on Tuesday it would be up to politicians to determine economic policy when a single European currency is introduced, not central bank governors.

"Under the treaty on monetary union, it's not the central bank which will have the power to outline the major thrust of economic policy or even exchange rate policy -- it will be the governments and political powers who will assume this responsiility," Juppe told the Senate.
Later, members of the Senate approved a motion of confidence in Juppe's centre-right government by a vote of 219 to 94.
